comparison.objective: Select the dry mould and pour a crucible using a two-hand shank; candidate commissions an axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual lift, carry, controlled pour, and upright replacement versus fine tool insertion, collar adjustment, counterhold, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: At least 90% of 36 beads enter dry mould, ≤3 spill, no wet-mould fill or hot-crucible grasp, then stable release versus two bounded-energy stops without bottoming or drift.
comparison.reason: Foundry pouring and hazard selection are unrelated to mechanical damper tuning.
